selection_policy: For a given (source, target function) the candidate mutations are enumerated in a fixed order: rules in the order listed below, and within a rule, occurrences in ascending source order. A mutation is accepted for a task only if it keeps the module syntactically valid and makes the official HumanEval check() fail.

rules.name: comparison_operator_swap
rules.description: Replace the comparison operator of a comparison expression with a different, logically adjacent operator (e.g. '>' becomes '>=').

rules.name: off_by_one_boundary
rules.description: Shift by +/- 1 an integer literal that sits in a boundary position (a comparison operand, a slice bound, a subscript index, a range() argument, or an operand of '+'/'-'), producing an off-by-one error.

rules.name: incorrect_constant
rules.description: Replace a numeric literal with a different numeric literal, changing a hard-coded constant.

rules.name: arithmetic_operator_swap
rules.description: Replace the arithmetic operator of a binary expression with a different operator (e.g. '+' becomes '-').

rules.name: boolean_operator_swap
rules.description: Replace a boolean connective ('and'/'or') with its counterpart, changing the short-circuit logic of a condition.
